title: IFERROR catches all worksheet errors, passes bare LAMBDA callables through as #CALC!, and preserves blank cells as empty
statement: In Excel 16.0.20527.20088, IFERROR(value, value_if_error) catches worksheet errors including #CALC!, #SPILL!, #FIELD!, and #GETTING_DATA, but a bare LAMBDA callable returned by value (such as IFS(TRUE,LAMBDA(xx,xx))) is not yet an error inside IFERROR, so IFERROR(IFS(TRUE,LAMBDA(xx,xx)),9) passes the callable through and produces #CALC! at the cell. A blank cell passed as value returns empty rather than empty text, so IFS(TRUE,IFERROR(A1,1))&"|" evaluates to "0|".
basis: Measured in Excel 16.0.20527.20088 in fn5_selection_boundaries (sheets q005 and q017) and Excel 16.0.20430.20182 (dc-ibp2), and matched across 4,182 of 4,182 full-bank IFERROR witness rows.
